**`/statechart` downloads tools the first time you use it.** with `mise` installed and `TLA2TOOLS` unset, the first model check installs tlc through mise, plus a temurin jdk unless `JAVA` is set, a few hundred mb with the jdk. the first png or `render` run installs two packages from npm into a cache folder. set `TLA2TOOLS`, and `JAVA` if `java` is not on your path, to skip the model-check download. it also runs a `<Spec>.map.mjs` beside a spec as javascript, so run it only on specs you trust. the skill's `SKILL.md` and `--help` describe what it installs.
